description: Makes a new Nod. Only name is required; parts left out use "default". It starts private. A trial account may hold 3 Nods. space "team" makes it in your team's space (teams only).

brain.description: A brain id from list_parts, or "default".

face.description: A face id from list_parts, or "default".

face_id.description: The avatar for the outside-anam face: your own Anam avatar id (your Anam key, added in Studio, pays), or a nodnod: id from list_faces. "" for none.

personality.description: Who the Nod is and how it talks, in plain words.

slug.description: The last part of the page address, <web>/<handle>/<slug>. Made from the name if left out.

space.description: "personal" (the default): yours, and it goes where you go. "team": made in your team's space; it stays with the team if you leave, and a team key is revoked when you do.

voice.description: A voice id from list_parts, or "default".

voice_id.description: The voice inside the voice part, from list_parts or the catalogue (am_fenrir, bf_emma...). "" for its default.

name: create_nod

brain_tier.description: fast: quick answers; big: slower and deeper.

face_id.description: The avatar inside the face: an Anam avatar id on your own Anam account, or a nodnod: id from list_faces.

voice_id.description: The voice inside the voice part (a Kokoro voice such as am_fenrir); "" for its default.

title: Create a Nod
